verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an agreement-management platform, but nothing in the evidence documents acting on many items at once (such as bulk send or batch envelope actions). Reusable templates, configurable workflows, the REST API/SDKs and the MCP connector are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not a documented bulk-operation capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
